beats.title: clearing up, safely
beats.screen_note: the "clear logs" button (page.tsx:987-997 — only rendered for site admins, `canManageLogs` at :444). Open it: the "clear event logs" dialog carries its own "from (optional)" / "to (optional)" pickers (:1234-1252) and builds a live scope list above them (:1215-1228). Set both dates and show the scope list gaining the from/to lines; then clear them to show the no-filters copy, "this will permanently delete ALL event logs for this site (across all machines)".
